output_example.note: Even-period bullet-bond schedule only (no odd first coupon / stub-period support, declared limitation). Macaulay duration = weighted-average time to cash flows (in years) using PV weights at the periodic yield; modified duration = Macaulay / (1 + periodic yield). day_count_convention is echoed for receipt transparency but the schedule itself assumes even periods.
